summary: Add an optional one-page cart presentation with selected-item controls, server-verified totals, idempotent create recovery and lifecycle-safe inline payment mounting; retain classic checkout compatibility.
evidence: Observed hosted /cart exposed zero-quantity products and separate check/create/payment steps; owner requested payment within cart.
commerce-core/test/checkout-cart.test.mjs: 14 passing regression cases including submit lock, one create, lost-response recovery, closed admission and inconsistent quote rejection.
rollback: Revert the scoped checkout-ui/test change; classic remains the default and payment/fulfillment admission is unchanged.
